item.coloph: zhes shar rdza'i grub dbang dam pa'i gsol 'debs 'di ni dad ldan skal bzang g.yung drung gis bskul ngor/ sman ri'i mkhan phun tshogs blo gros kyis phul ba ste/ dam pa 'di yi mdzad byang rnams ni rang re bon rnying ma'i rgyud sde thams cad kyi dgongs don gcig tu bsdus pa/ rgyal ba mnyam med chen po'i rigs lugs dang mi 'gal ba zab dgu'i snying por gyur 'dug pa/ rang cag bon po rnams kyis spyi bo'i gtsug tu bkur te/ tshe gcig gi byang chub sgrub pa la 'bad na gdams pa 'di las zab pa gzhan du btsal mi dgos pa 'dug pas de skad rjes 'jug rnams la gdams te zhang zhung sgo pa khyung po dkar ru'i sa cha nas shing glang zla tshes la phul //
zhes pa'i gsol 'debs 'di'ang rtag zhig rtogs ldan seng ge nyi mas phul ba dge'o//
zhe+es pa'ang hUM chen pas so//

ces sa gsum na 'gran pa'i zla bral sprul pa'i gter chen bde chen gling pa'i sras rgyud du 'khrungs pa'i rgyal sras bstan 'dzin tshul khrims dbang gi rgyal po dang / khyung spal g.yung drung mchog dbang rnam gnyis gtsor zhe zhol dgon gyi rang slob sum cu lhag gis khyi la seng gzigs kyis 'di lta bu zhig dgos zhes bskul ngor dbul pos phyug por khas blang lta bu'i gsol 'debs 'di yang shar rdza pas so//
ces pa'ang tshe dbang g.yung drung 'gyur med kyis bskul ngor 7gsang sngags gling pas so//
